sentences.text:
It is submitted that, in terms of the said agreement, the petitioner was to transfer property bearing Plot No. BC/36, Ansal East End,
Loni, Ghaziabad, U.P., in the name of the respondent on or before 10.10.2024.

As per the settlement, a petition for divorce by mutual consent was to be filed thereafter, and upon grant of a decree of divorce, a petition for quashing of FIR No. 118/2022, under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC,
registered at P.S. Dwarka South, was to be filed.
5. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the said property was transferred in the name of the wife in May 2025.
However, since the respondent did not honour her part of the obligation, a legal notice was sent to her.

In reply to the said notice, it was averred on behalf of the respondent that although the property had been transferred in her name, the petitioner had not handed over the original chain of title documents of the property, and therefore, she was not obliged to comply with the terms of the aforesaid agreement.

6. Issue notice to respondent, on petitioner taking necessary steps, through all permissible modes,
including electronic mail, if any, returnable on 25.09.2025.
This is a digitally signed order.
